review_note: UNRESOLVED CH + HSSH: the candidate partition comprises the three-electron CH frontier span plus the occupied sulfur donor on bound S2, CAS(5,4). This is a hypothesis, not an approved production model. The fixed-orbital controls preserve the original frontier exactly: opening source 18 changes the near-minus-far D1 energy by -0.9402/-0.9300 kcal/mol (DZ/TZ), versus -0.0831/-0.0792 for source 19. Near source 18 is S2-rich; 19 is the distal S3 lone pair. The proposed source natural indices are 18,20,21,22 from the optimized CAS(3,3) checkpoint; the noncontiguous indices deliberately include the chemically participating donor. Do not publish the fixed-CASCI checkpoint or substitute the optimized CAS(7,5) union, whose occupied directions reorganize. The new CAS(5,4) partition has controlled CI evidence, not a separately verified optimized CAS(5,4) curve. It cannot pass the review gate without that evidence. Two equal doublets would support the CH spatial pair; the proposed reactive state is D1. These are evidence-based chemical active-space choices. They do not certify quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular, relaxed-path or plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital/state/connectivity guards. Retain direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz CBS power 3.7, a separate 30 A asymptote, and the existing mapped correction coordinate and COM dividing surfaces. No existing production model is changed here.
